tools.name: find_facilities
tools.title: Find clinics, hospitals and pharmacies
tools.description: Search MediQueue's Ugu District (KwaZulu-Natal) healthcare facilities by name, area or service. Returns address, opening hours, phone, services and the current crowdsourced waiting time.

query.description: Name, town or service to match, e.g. 'Margate' or 'TB'.

tools.name: check_medicine_availability
tools.title: Check medicine stock
tools.description: Look up which MediQueue clinics, hospitals and pharmacies currently have a medicine in stock, so patients avoid unnecessary travel.

medicine.description: Medicine name or category, e.g. 'Metformin' or 'HIV'.

tools.name: my_medical_records
tools.title: My medical records
tools.description: List the signed-in MediQueue patient's own medical records (visit date, condition, diagnosis, treatment, prescription and facility).

limit.description: Maximum records to return, newest first.

tools.name: my_queue_status
tools.title: My clinic queue status
tools.description: Show the signed-in MediQueue patient's current and recent clinic queue tickets, including ticket number, facility, department, priority and status.
